sources.articleTitle: Watch: IAF IL-76 makes world-record landing in Ladakh's Nyoma
IAF’s IL-76 heavy-lift plane makes record 13,600-foot touchdown at Nyoma airbase in eastern Ladakh

headline: Indian Air Force IL-76 Aircraft Lands At High-Altitude Nyoma Base
seoTitle: IAF IL-76 Lands At Nyoma Base
metaDescription: An Indian Air Force IL-76 transport plane successfully landed at the Mudh-Nyoma airfield in Ladakh, enhancing military logistics near the border.
aiSummaryBullets: An Indian Air Force IL-76 transport plane achieved a landing at the Mudh-Nyoma airfield in eastern Ladakh.
The airfield is situated at an elevation of approximately 13,600 to 13,700 feet, making it one of the highest bases for heavy-lift aircraft.
The development is part of a broader government initiative to strengthen airbase infrastructure and operational logistics near the Line of Actual Control.
aiContextParagraph: The Indian Air Force has successfully conducted a landing operation with an IL-76MD heavy-lift transport aircraft at the Mudh-Nyoma airbase in eastern Ladakh. Situated at an elevation between 13,600 and 13,700 feet, the airfield is designated as a high-altitude, fighter-capable facility. This maneuver demonstrates the increased operational capacity of the Indian military to conduct rapid deployment of troops and heavy equipment in challenging mountain terrain. The effort aligns with ongoing strategic objectives by the Defence Ministry to modernize and expand infrastructure across various Advanced Landing Grounds located near the Line of Actual Control. By enhancing these sites, the military aims to improve regional logistics, ensuring more efficient supply chains and response capabilities during critical operational circumstances in the high-altitude sector.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention across major Indian news outlets due to the logistical achievement of landing heavy-lift aircraft at extreme altitudes.
